ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels account for approximately 85% of the surface area, with high-intensity (white) highlights concentrated at the distal tips and along the splashing water line.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous low-intensity regions occupy the central and inner lobe areas. Diffuse medium-intensity grey mottling is mapped to the distal half of the right lobe. High-intensity focal spots are localized at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Extremely high-frequency serrations with irregular pixel amplitudes (varying 3-10 pixels) across the entire visible trailing edge, creating a jagged, non-linear boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex sweep trajectory from the median notch to the distal tips, with a slight upward vertical incline at the lateral extremities.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular jaggedness along the trailing edge suggesting significant past trauma or environmental wear; multiple distinct rake marks on the ventral surface of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A prominent, singular dark vertical stroke-like mark is visible on the mid-outer region of the left lobe, distinct from the finer surrounding rake marks.
